title: Petersen's two-factorization of even-regular graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph, and suppose $G$ is regular of degree $2k$ for some natural number $k$, meaning every vertex has exactly $2k$ neighbours. Then $G$ is $2$-factorable: its edges decompose into finitely many pairwise edge-disjoint $2$-factors, that is, edge-disjoint $2$-regular spanning subgraphs whose union is all of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
